extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet is headed 2N3906S and identifies a KEC PNP epitaxial planar transistor; the exact requested catalog identity is MPN 2N3906S-RTK/PS.

PNP collector-current, base-current, collector-emitter-voltage, base-emitter-voltage, VCE(sat), and VBE(sat) values retain the datasheet negative signs. Curve axes labeled in mA, pF, MHz, or nS were represented in SI units A, F, Hz, or s where used in the strict schema.
Curve points are sparse manual digitizations at visible grid positions from the typical characteristic plots on p. 3; no points were interpolated between sampled observations.

The DC current gain table provides minimum hFE values at IC = -0.1, -1, -10, -50, and -100 mA, plus a maximum of 300 at -10 mA. The guaranteed range at -10 mA is preserved as separate minimum and maximum gain points.

VCE(sat)1 and VCE(sat)2 are maximum limits of -0.25 V at IC = -10 mA, IB = -1 mA and -0.4 V at IC = -50 mA, IB = -5 mA. VBE(sat)1 publishes a minimum of -0.65 V and maximum of -0.85 V; VBE(sat)2 publishes a maximum of -0.95 V.

The p. 1 maximum ratings table also publishes VCBO = -40 V, VCEO = -40 V, VEBO = -5 V, IC = -200 mA, IB = -50 mA, PC = 350 mW, Tj = 150 degC, and Tstg = -55 to 150 degC; fields not represented by the strict schema were not added outside it.
omission_reason: VAF/Early voltage, VCBO, VEBO, continuous IC, base current, power and thermal absolute ratings, switching times, leakage limits, input impedance, voltage feedback ratio, small-signal hfe, and collector output admittance are not represented by this strict BJT extraction schema.
